module: "ParkingSpot" class of a sites set: an oriented rectangle (position, rotation, dimensions scl = width X, length Y, height Z) representing a parking spot. Allows testing whether a vehicle fits in it, whether it is parked in it, whether it is occupied, and teleporting a vehicle into it. Can generate several side-by-side spots ("multi-spot"). The module returns a constructor.
usage:
local ok, corners = spot:checkParking(vehId, 0.8, 5, 1)
if spot:vehicleFits(vehId) and not spot:hasAnyVehicles(vehId) then
  spot:moveResetVehicleTo(vehId, false, false, nil, nil, true)
end
notes: Local axes: X = width, Y = direction of the spot (front), Z = height; scl holds the total dimensions.
Multiple spots (isMultiSpot) are expanded by generateMultiSpots during finalizeSites: the copies are marked isProcedural and have no debug drawing of their own.
multiSpotData.spotDirection is 'Left', 'Right', 'Front' or 'Back'. If another value is given, the offset stays that of the last computation (shared temporary variable).
checkParking: speeds are compared to the square of the speed norm (m/s). Defaults: drivingSpeed 5 m/s, parkingSpeed 1 m/s, precision 0.8.

moveResetVehicleTo in non-safeTeleport mode always multiplies the final quaternion by backwardsQuat (180° rotation around Z), even if backwards is false; the returned quaternion is modified in place by this multiplication.

C.desc: Parking spot object. Fields: sites, id, name, color, vertices (4 2D corners), pos, rot, scl, isMultiSpot, multiSpotData {spotAmount, spotOffset, spotDirection, spotRotation}, wasGenerated, isProcedural, customFields.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the spot (position, original rotation, dimensions, multi-spot parameters, color, custom fields).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the spot from the data and recalculates the corners.

set.desc: Changes position, rotation and/or dimensions (nil values ignored) and recalculates the corners.

getPath.desc: Text identifier of the spot: folder + file of the sites set + "#" + name.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the spot in debug (surface, direction, name depending on the mode). Ignores procedural spots.

drawSide.desc: Draws a vertical side of the spot between two points (debug aid).

generateMultiSpots.desc: For a multi-spot, creates the additional spots (name "<name>.<n>") offset according to spotDirection/spotOffset, with the spotRotation rotation, and copies tags and custom fields. Acts only once (wasGenerated).

parkingSpotList.desc: Sorted list (sites.parkingSpots) in which to create the spots.

skipSort.desc: Do not re-sort on each creation.

calcVerts.desc: Recalculates the 4 2D corners (vertices) from pos, rot and scl.

containsPoint.desc: Tests whether a point is inside the spot's volume (oriented box, with a quick radius check).

checkParking.desc: Checks whether a vehicle is correctly parked: low speed, aligned with the spot's axis (|cos| >= 0.707) and the corners of its bounding box inside. With precision <= 0, only the vehicle's center is tested.

precision.desc: Fraction (0..1) from the center toward each corner to test; default 0.8.

parkingSpeed.desc: Max speed (m/s) to be valid; default 1.

returns.desc: State of the 4 corners (order depends on front/back).

boxFits.desc: Tests whether a box of given dimensions fits in the spot's dimensions (per-axis comparison, no rotation).

vehicleFits.desc: Tests whether the vehicle fits (initial node bounding box, initialNodePosBB).

returns.desc: true if it fits; false if the vehicle does not exist.

hasAnyVehicles.desc: Indicates whether an active vehicle occupies the spot (bounding box center inside it; for vehicles tracked by map, edges are also tested).

playerId.desc: Identifier of a vehicle to ignore.

returns.desc: true if at least one vehicle.
Identifiers of the vehicles present (may contain duplicates).

moveResetVehicleTo.desc: Places a vehicle on the spot, aligned to its rotation. With useSafeTeleport, goes through spawn.safeTeleport; otherwise computes the bounding box offset, positions the vehicle, resets the flexmesh and calls autoplace.

lowPrecision.desc: To use if the vehicle has just been loaded on the first frame (invalid OOBB): places the vehicle 2 m behind and 0.5 m above.

backwards.desc: Orient the vehicle in the opposite direction.

options.desc: Options; skipVehicleIntersectionCheck is passed to safeTeleport.

returns.desc: New position (nil if vehicle not found).
